invoices_paid_at_check.name: invoices_paid_at_check
invoices_paid_at_check.value: "invoices"."status" not in ('paid', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded') or "invoices"."paid_at" is not null

licenses_revoke_check.name: licenses_revoke_check
licenses_revoke_check.value: ("licenses"."revoked_at" is null and "licenses"."revoke_reason" is null) or ("licenses"."revoked_at" is not null and "licenses"."revoke_reason" in ('refunded', 'dispute_lost'))

licenses_source_check.name: licenses_source_check
licenses_source_check.value: ("licenses"."plan" = 'desktop' and "licenses"."order_id" is not null and "licenses"."subscription_id" is null) or ("licenses"."plan" = 'pro' and "licenses"."subscription_id" is not null and "licenses"."period_start" is not null)

orders_paid_at_check.name: orders_paid_at_check
orders_paid_at_check.value: "orders"."status" not in ('paid', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded') or "orders"."paid_at" is not null

subscriptions_interval_check.name: subscriptions_interval_check
subscriptions_interval_check.value: ("subscriptions"."kind" = 'pro' and "subscriptions"."interval" is not null and "subscriptions"."interval" in ('month', 'year')) or ("subscriptions"."kind" = 'api' and "subscriptions"."interval" is null)

subscriptions_spend_cap_check.name: subscriptions_spend_cap_check
subscriptions_spend_cap_check.value: ("subscriptions"."kind" = 'pro' and "subscriptions"."spend_cap_cents" is null) or ("subscriptions"."kind" = 'api' and "subscriptions"."spend_cap_cents" is not null and "subscriptions"."spend_cap_cents" > 0)

checkouts_spend_cap_check.name: checkouts_spend_cap_check
checkouts_spend_cap_check.value: ("checkouts"."product" = 'api' and "checkouts"."spend_cap_cents" is not null and "checkouts"."spend_cap_cents" > 0) or ("checkouts"."product" <> 'api' and "checkouts"."spend_cap_cents" is null)
